instrument_type_details.notes: At December 31, 2003: NO options in place for any period. Company stopped hedging entirely in 2003 — no call options purchased for any future quarter. Estimated 2004 fuel consumption ~86M gal. Item8_notes notes $1.1M reclassified from OCI to income in 2003 as offset to fuel expense (from expiring 2002 options). Company resumed hedging in 2004 (collars for 2005).

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel and oil and associated taxes increased $2.4 million, or 3.1%, from 2002 to $81.1 million in 2003. Into-plane fuel prices increased 21.5% in 2003, averaging $1.01 per gallon in 2003 versus $0.83 per gallon in 2002. Fuel consumption decreased 15.1% in 2003. [Derived: $81.1M / $1.01 = 80.3M gallons]
